summary: California Resources Corp filed an 8-K announcing a proposed private offering of $550M senior unsecured notes due 2035. Net proceeds, with credit facility borrowings or cash, will fund redemption of all outstanding $550M 8.250% senior notes due 2029 at 104.125% plus accrued interest. Redemption is conditioned on the note offering; the offering is not contingent on redemption. This is a straightforward debt refinancing — the issuer is replacing existing notes with new ones to extend maturity and manage cost. No equity, M&A, or special situation is involved. Watch for market reception of new notes and redemption mechanics but no risk-arb angle.
